item.title: Scaling Is No Longer a Bigger Number
item.description: Ask anyone about a large language model and the first question is still: how many parameters? The question itself deserves a challenge. What does parameter count actually tell you, on its own? Over the past few years the industry spent real money testing the answer, and the answer is: almost nothing. Parameter count only means something next to three other facts — how much data the model saw, where the compute went, and under what conditions it runs.
